# Field reference

Every field a template can receive. The tests fail if a template does not render each
field in the first table (or list it under `ignores` with a reason).

## Fields a template must render

| Field | Applies to | What it is | How to render it | Shown when empty |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `university.name` | both modes | The chosen university's name (or the custom name typed in). | `ctx.f('university.name')` | `Lorem Ipsum University` |
| `university.logo` | both modes | The logo, already sized and positioned for you. Always place it with ctx.logo(). | `ctx.logo()` | `(placeholder drawing)` |
| `assignment.type` | both modes | What kind of document this is, e.g. "Assignment". | `ctx.f('assignment.type')` | `Lorem ipsum` |
| `assignment.title` | both modes | Title of the work. May contain line breaks. | `ctx.f('assignment.title')` | `Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit` |
| `course.code` | both modes | Course code, e.g. "ECO101". | `ctx.f('course.code')` | `LOR101` |
| `course.section` | both modes | Section number only, without the word "Section". | `ctx.f('course.section')` | `1` |
| `course.title` | both modes | Full course title. | `ctx.f('course.title')` | `Dolor sit amet` |
| `faculty.name` | both modes | Teacher the work is submitted to. | `ctx.f('faculty.name')` | `Dr. Lorem Ipsum` |
| `faculty.designation` | both modes | Teacher's designation. | `ctx.f('faculty.designation')` | `Senior Lecturer` |
| `faculty.department` | both modes | Teacher's department. | `ctx.f('faculty.department')` | `Department of Dolor` |
| `submission.mode` | both modes | Either "individual" or "group". Branch your layout on it. | `ctx.mode  // 'individual' \| 'group'` | — |
| `individual.name` | individual only | Student's name (individual mode). | `ctx.f('individual.name')` | `Lorem Ipsum Dolor` |
| `individual.id` | individual only | Student ID (individual mode). | `ctx.f('individual.id')` | `2411234567` |
| `individual.department` | individual only | Student's department. Picked from the university's list, or typed. | `ctx.f('individual.department')` | `Department of Sit Amet` |
| `individual.extra` | individual only | Optional free text. Render it only when ctx.has("individual.extra") is true. | `ctx.has('individual.extra') ? ctx.f('individual.extra') : ''` | nothing (optional) |
| `group.number` | group only | Group number (group mode). | `ctx.f('group.number')` | `1` |
| `group.members` | group only | List of { name, id } rows (group mode). Rows already skip empty entries. | `ctx.members()  // [{ name, id }, …]` | `(two sample members)` |
| `submission.date` | both modes | Already formatted as "3 February 2031". | `ctx.f('submission.date')` | `1 January 2026` |
| `submission.semester` | both modes | Semester and year, e.g. "Fall 2026". | `ctx.f('submission.semester')` | `Lorem 2026` |

## Layout fields — handled by the page engine

You do not render these. The core applies them. Use the CSS variables where noted.

| Field | What it controls | Range or values |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `logo.size` | Logo size | 40 to 200 % |
| `logo.position` | Logo position | left, center, right |
| `page.linked` | Same margin on every side | on or off |
| `page.margin` | Margin | 0.5 to 2.5 in |
| `page.marginX` | Left and right margin | 0.5 to 2.5 in |
| `page.marginY` | Top and bottom margin | 0.5 to 2.5 in |
| `page.align` | Content alignment | left, center, right |

CSS variables your template can use: `--gc-align` (left, center, right), `--gc-justify`
(flex-start, center, flex-end), `--gc-logo-base` (set it to size the logo at 100%).

## Fields that feed other fields

| Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `template` | Template |
| `university.id` | University |
| `university.customName` | University name |
| `logo.custom` | Logo image |
